Subject: MAP: Legal redlines & MSA/DPA/SLA ownership - Acme

Hi John —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery + MAP kickoff: 

Summary of the call:
- Product fit looks strong for Acme's customer support use case (low-latency embeddings + streaming chat).
- Target technical POC: integration with existing ticketing pipeline (2-week sandbox).
- Commercial ask: target close for initial contract July 15, 2025.

Immediate MAP milestone we discussed: legal review for MSA/DPA/SLA redlines.
I attached the initial MAP + our current MSA export so we have a single source of truth. Can you confirm Acme's preferred process for handling legal redlines? Specifically: 

- Who will own the first pass redline (Acme legal vs Redwood legal)?
- Preferred turnaround times for each pass (we propose 3 business days for initial redlines from either side, 2 business days for follow-up counters).
- Which doc format do you prefer (Word redline / PDF / Acrobat)?

Proposed short-term plan (for the MAP):
- Responsibility: Redwood owns tracking of redline versions in the MAP and will maintain a single "open items" tab.
- Turnaround target: 3 business days for first pass, 2 business days for counters.
- Decision owner: Acme legal for final approvals (signature).
- Dependencies: Acme to provide any non-standard contract clauses by June 30; Procurement to confirm billing/legal contacts.

Attachments: [Attachment: Acme-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: Acme-Redwood-MSA-v0.1-redline.pdf (PDF snapshot)].

Can you confirm these ownership items and whether the July 15 target looks feasible? If OK, I'll schedule a 30-minute legal sync next week and circulate an updated MAP with an explicit responsibility matrix.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

- Acme legal will take the first pass on the MSA and DPA redlines. I'll ask Beth (cc'ed) to run point on that.

Marissa / John —

Thanks for including legal. A few items from Acme Legal's perspective:

- Our standard process: we aim to produce an initial redline within 5 business days for MSAs and 10 business days for DPAs if we need to engage privacy counsel. If Redwood can accept an expedited cadence for the MSA (3 business days), please confirm in writing.
- Preferred deliverable: Word .docx redline for the MSA; clean PDF is fine for reference but not for edits.
- SLA specifics: please provide a short list of the proposed SLA metrics and remedies (uptime %, credits formula). We will push back on unlimited liability and expect a negotiated cap; please indicate Redwood's standard liability cap and any carve-outs.
- For efficiency, please provide a single column "ownership" matrix in the MAP as proposed by Aditya.

We are available for a 30-minute legal sync on Tues 6/30 or Wed 7/1 morning PST — propose Tue 6/30 at 10:00am PT.

Best,
